- **US3 Tags** — add/remove, autocomplete suggestions (datalist), tag filter dropdown, clickable tags, unused-tag pruning.
- **US4 Edit/dedup/delete** — full edit, re-saving an existing address opens it, address-collision → 409, confirmed delete with tag + preserved-file cleanup.
- **US5 Read-later** — unread default, mark read/unread, dedicated Unread view.
- **US6 Archive/restore** — hidden from normal list + search, dedicated Archived view, restore; independent of delete.
- **US7 Bulk actions** — multi-select and "select all matching" (incl. off-screen), bulk add/remove tags, read/archive status, delete; verified at 120 items.
- **US8 Sorting & preferences** — 4 sort orders; persistent default sort, items shown, text size (applied live).
- **US9 Saved searches** — create/run/edit/delete with included/excluded tags.
- **US10 Import/export** — Netscape bookmark file; import preserves title, tags, original date-added, skips existing, reports added/skipped; malformed → clear error.
- **US11 Preservation** — single self-contained HTML via SingleFile driving the **shared Chromium** (no second browser downloaded; verified against live example.com), PDFs kept as PDFs, Internet Archive snapshot link; graceful failure.
- **US12 Notes** — Markdown authored, rendered + sanitized on view.
- **Polish** — 600-bookmark performance check (<1s), persistence-across-restart check, e2e smoke, error handling, list truncation, harness verification.

### Two honesty notes
- **Import transport**: the API accepts the bookmark file as a raw `text/html` body (the browser reads the file and posts its contents) rather than `multipart/form-data` as the contract sketched.
